scenes.name: indignant-temple
scenes.action: Eight-second silent pantomime. 0-2s: he straightens, puts his left hand on his hip and gives an indignant head tilt with raised shoulders. 2-5s: he raises the right gloved hand beside his RIGHT TEMPLE, extends only the index finger, and makes TWO distinct small circular rotations with the fingertip right beside the temple, the familiar incredulous 'crazy' gesture. The fingertip must actually trace little circles, not wave or just point. Keep the hand at the side of the head, never over the face. 5-6s: a short head shake and one compact palm-up gesture. 6-8s: lower both hands and settle into the starting pose. Clear anticipation, quick readable gestures and brief holds, natural hood and jacket follow-through. No speech, symbols, drawn circles, trails, magic, liquids or props.

scenes.name: snap-fire-innocent
scenes.action: Ten-second playful pantomime, events strictly in this order. 0-2s: standing still, he lifts one gloved hand and visibly snaps thumb and middle finger ONCE. 2-4s: ONLY after the snap, a small orange flame appears on the invisible floor immediately in front of his right boot; it rises briefly to ankle height. He looks down, surprised, with a small shoulder recoil. 4-6s: he lifts that boot and stamps directly onto the flame twice, fully extinguishing it. No stamping before ignition. 6-9s: once the flame is completely gone, he plants both feet, hides both hands behind his back, raises his chin and looks UP with exaggerated innocent composure, holding the pose as if nothing happened. 9-10s: return calmly to the neutral reference pose. No lighter, matches, fuel, extra objects or scenery. Keep flame compact and fully within the frame; no smoke plume, residual embers or broad glow. No talking or whistling. Eye shapes stay ivory. The glow stays local to the flame without recolouring the green background.

All emotion is silent body language and the existing eyes. Preserve reference materials and anatomy.
